preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10.
Number of officers is between 1 and 100,000.
Chef's initial coordinate is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= P[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each officer's initial coordinate is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(P[i] != C for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Chef's initial coordinate is different from all officers' initial coordinates.

preconditions.expression: all(P[i] != P[j] for i in range(N) for j in range(i + 1, N))
preconditions.description: All officers' initial coordinates are unique.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, tuple) and len(result) == 2 for result in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly two integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result[0], int) and 0 <= result[0] <= N for result in return_value)
postconditions.description: The first integer in each output line is the number of officers eliminated, between 0 and N.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result[1], int) and result[1] in [-1, 1] for result in return_value)
postconditions.description: The second integer in each output line is either -1 (Chef is caught) or 1 (Chef runs away).
